name: AcceptInfrastructureWorkbookRun
pure_preflight: complete disposition/fingerprint validation and deterministic mutation plan
transaction_boundary: one all-or-nothing outer UnitOfWork; all manual-domain reducers are receipt-free participants
guards: same-installation IDs only direct-target when scope matches
receipt_order: replay checks -> all current-state revalidation -> one receipt -> ordered receipt-free reducers -> row decisions/run/proposals/replay index -> audit -> commit
mutations: selected LLD-08 domain tables through exact reducers
revision_effects: only selected material domain changes increment owning revisions; unchanged/rejected rows do not
post_commit_work: terminal staging/proposal cleanup only after commit
